name: Ron Goellner Conservation Fund and Jennifer Elwood Hellbender Conservation Grant

funder.name: Cryptobranchid Interest Group (AZA Amphibian Taxon Advisory Group)

summary: Small grants for projects on giant salamanders and hellbenders, including field conservation of the species and their habitats and threat mitigation. One application covers both grants.

amount.note: Goellner fund up to $2,000; the hellbender-only Elwood grant up to $1,000

reporting: Awardees recognise the grant in all publications and presentations, provide copies of reports and publications to the group, and submit a progress report 12 months after the award.

status.quote: Please click HERE for application and instructions to apply for the 2026 Ron Goellner Conservation Fund and Jennifer Elwood Hellbender Conservation Grant.

recurring.quote: by August 31st. Should the CIG grant committee recommend your project for funding, and it is approved in the budget process

access.quote: Each applicant will automatically be considered for both grants when submitting this single application.

amount.quote: The Cryptobranchid Interest Group (CIG) will consider proposals for two separate grants for amounts up to $2,000 each.

reporting.quote: the awardee(s) is required to recognize the CIG grant(s) in all publications and presentations. Copies of reports and publications are to be provided to CIG and reports of progress are to be submitted 12 months after award is received.

window.quote: by August 31st. Should the CIG grant committee recommend your project for funding, and it is approved in the budget process
